content.text:
**Finding: compliant (preferred level) — no redline proposed.**

Northwind already holds the full preferred T4C bargain:

| Preferred element | Where met |
|---|---|
| Customer convenience termination of Agreement or Order Form | §9.4 — "without cause", unconditional Customer election |
| ≤30 days' written notice | §29.4 — thirty days before effective termination date |
| Pro-rata refund of prepaid fees | §9.4 (accrued Fees only) + §10.2 |
| No Vendor mid-term convenience right | §§9.1–9.2 for-cause and mutual; §§9.3–9.4 Customer-only; §24.4 blocks change-of-control termination |

Boundary calls made: §8.2 non-renewal is a Customer-only right and sits under RENEWAL, not T4C; §7.7 late-payment liquidated damages is not an early-termination fee and belongs to the liquidated-damages rule, so it is not double-flagged here.
